coverage_exempt.reason: Coordinator verified the hash-pinned original: entry override x != -1 changes every nonzero camera state to 0x22b8 at 0x48628d, so the state-24 path reaching 0x486440 starts with override x == -1; it has no intervening calls or writes to that global. Therefore its override-store arm is unreachable for the returning object domain. All bytes remain owned and translated.

equivalent_mutants.reason: Drops the zero initialization of newly allocated state+0. The same valid fresh allocation is overwritten by player x before any read of that field or outside call; no existing object aliases the new allocation.
Drops zero initialization of newly allocated state+8. targetPlayer overwrites that target-x field from player x before any read of it or outside call; no existing object aliases the fresh allocation.

Moves zero initialization from fresh state+0xc to state+0x10. The next statement writes state+0x10 to zero again and targetPlayer overwrites state+0xc before any read of that field or outside call; allocation remains valid and distinct.

limits: operator new uses the shared deterministic allocation fixture.
rand is scripted at the CRT boundary while camera-shake game code executes unchanged.
GetCursorPos uses a case-supplied POINT output.
PostMessageA records the requested message without posting to Windows.
SetCursorPos records coordinates without moving a real cursor.
joyGetPosEx uses a case-supplied 52-byte joystick state.
notes: Reviewed 14-entry scene surface: seven scene_camera roots plus seven explicit whole callees owned solely by application_input_configuration. The scene gate executes unowned input callees as original code; this does not prove native composition. The admission task must retain direct coverage of all 14 entries across the two elected owners and original/native delegation comparisons. See menu-scene-camera-owner-review ownership_review in tools/queue.json and packet NOTES.md. Both binding poll/reset return u32 success 1. Legacy SceneCameraRuntime.cpp/.h and claw_scene_camera_entry exports remain untouched; the separate canonical module uses claw_scene_camera_canonical_entry. __ftol remains original-backed with one ST(0) operand; other unlisted game callees remain original-backed.
